question: Native ARDY root conditioning (training-layer) was inaccurate in M1/M2 (C0 end error equal to the offset). M2 receipts show the C0 window end moving 1-4 mm toward the target. The M1/M2 task places the target at the last frame of an 8-frame (0.4 s) window, visible only inside that window; the official demo exposes constraints up to 160 frames ahead as future tokens. P0 asks whether native conditioning reaches fixed goals when given lookahead, and how it compares with output-layer MotionCorrection at the goal window

development_smoke.data: develop_logs/test_runs/20261102_p0/smoke_a (in-window layouts, task 10 seed 20), smoke_b (lookahead 0/1/2/4 s, task 2 seed 20), smoke_c (G0/G4/W0g/G4W, tasks 10 and 17 seed 20); not analyzed
observed: In-window constraint layouts (last frame, last token, every frame ramped) with constraint weight 2 or 10 move the window end 0.3-8% of the offset
Lookahead 4 s: goal error 2-19 mm on three tasks; lookahead 0 s: error equal to the offset; lookahead 1-2 s: mostly within 3 cm with occasional failures up to 2.9 m and 5-10x the 0.1 s jerk
W0g (output-only correction on the goal window): error 0.040 m, boundary jerk 18-40x G0; G4W: correction moves the root 1-3 cm, kinematics as G4

seed_note: Fresh seeds; M1/V4 used 20-22, M2 23-25, smokes 20
cluster_unit: task (G = 24); seeds and offsets are paired repetitions within a task
pairing: Same task, seed and offset across every arm; arm order randomized within each task-seed block with Random(1000*(600+task)+seed)
tasks: task_geometry.ardy_offset_tasks(): 8 body headings x 3 text schedules, prompt updates as M1/M2
goal_task: Goals at 4, 8, 12, 16 s; each goal is the root XZ of the same-seed unconstrained run (same prompt schedule) at that frame plus sign*offset along the task lateral direction, signs +,-,+,-. A goal is exposed as a native Root2D future constraint from lookahead_seconds before its frame; num_frames grows to show it (official window budget 10 s)

G0.role: native conditioning, goal visible only inside the window that holds it (M2 C0 information)

W0g.role: output-layer correction: official MotionCorrection on the window holding the goal, output only (M2 W0 rule)

G4W.role: official demo combination: 4 s lookahead plus output-only MotionCorrection on the goal window

primary.family: Three hypotheses, Holm-adjusted at 0.05 over the exact sign-flip p values; each also requires its interval on the stated side. One value per run (mean over its 4 goals for goal error), pooled over both offsets, equal-weight task means of paired differences
primary.H1: Positive control: G4 - G0 goal error < 0, and the G4 cell mean goal error <= 0.05 m at each offset
primary.H2: G4 - W0g jerk at the 0.1 s step < 0
primary.H3: G4 - W0g foot sliding non-inferior with margin +0.05: test of (difference - 0.05) < 0
primary.decision: H1 decides whether native conditioning works when given lookahead. H1 and H2 together support 'training-layer conditioning reaches the goal without the jerk cost of output-layer correction'; H3 adds foot sliding

secondary: Lookahead dose G0/G1/G2/G4: goal error, goal success <= 0.05 m, goal failure > 0.5 m, 0.1 s jerk, boundary jerk, foot sliding, trunk inclination
G4W - G4 on every metric: cost of adding output correction when native conditioning already reaches the goal
G4 - G0 on kinematic metrics: kinematic cost of goal reaching itself
Per-offset cells of every metric and wall time
A later E1-style OpenSim evaluation (residual force) of G0, G4, W0g and G4W is a separate registration

inference.primary: Equal-weight task means of paired differences; cluster t interval with G-1 degrees of freedom and exact sign-flip p
inference.supplementary: Cluster bootstrap alongside, never as the decision interval

grid: 6 arms x 2 offsets x 24 tasks x 3 seeds
estimated_hours: about 2.5 on two GPUs (about 19 s per run)

pilot.jobs: Offset task 10, seed 26, every arm and offset (12 runs); reused by the batch
pilot.admission: Finite complete outputs; time within 3x the 19 s estimate; 4 goal receipts per run at 4/8/12/16 s; one reference run per job; window num_frames <= 200 and > history+horizon only while a goal is within lookahead; corrected arms correct exactly the 4 goal windows; G0 and W0g identical before the first goal window and G4 and G4W identical before the first goal window (root XZ, 1e-6 m)

conventions_not_derived: Goal times 4/8/12/16 s and alternating signs; offsets 0.5/1.0 m; lookahead 1/2/4 s; foot-sliding margin +0.05 as M2; correction margin 0.04 m as M1/M2
